title: Simulation Reality
subtitle: Test your grasp of Simulation Reality — Aether software, Custodian hijack, NPCs, Projection Dome, Amnesia Vortex, control strings, and the G.A.A. uninstall.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Simulation Reality is the controlled 3rd-density prison running on Aether software — hijacked by Custodians from a once-vibrant 9th-density Gateway-10 plain. NPCs, Overlays, Black Void Plasma, the Projection Dome, and the Amnesia Vortex are not metaphors; they are the harvest machine. Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge are the three strings that keep the mind hooked. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Simulation Reality deep-dive. G.A.A. opens with EBS truth, Bluebeam invasion theater, dome death into white Dark Matter, and a 30-second EMF flash that evaporates the synthetic 97%. Hold frequency as a genuine soul — the uninstall does not wait for permission.

questions.question: Where does humanity actually exist, relative to the globe-in-vacuum story sold as science?

options.label: A
options.text: On an unregulated natural plain with no software layer, no density management, and no parasitic interference of any kind.
options.rationale: The realm is software-managed and heavily corrupted by Custodians, not an untouched natural plain.

options.label: B
options.text: Inside a highly controlled, tightly managed, and heavily corrupted Simulation — an artificial 3rd-density physical environment, not a spinning globe in a vacuum.
options.rationale: Humanity is entrapped in a corrupted 3rd-density Simulation, not living on a spinning globe in open vacuum.

options.label: C
options.text: On a free-spinning planetary ball orbiting a nuclear star through infinite vacuum space, exactly as textbooks and space agencies insist.
options.rationale: The globe-in-vacuum model is the cover story. Humanity sits inside a controlled simulation, not on a ball in space.

options.label: D
options.text: Only in dream states and meditation; waking physical life is pure unprogrammed organic reality without simulation parameters.
options.rationale: Waking physical life itself is the simulated 3rd-density construct; it is not limited to dreams or meditation.

questions.hint: Not a globe in vacuum — a controlled 3rd-density Simulation.
